'''Sprigmelons''' were a type of [[Melon/Legends|melon]] that could be found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. At one point, an individual known as the [[Grudakk]] made a [[Stew/Legends|stew]] from many ingredients, among them sprigmelons, and served it to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]].<ref name="AoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sprigmelons appeared in the [[1984]] young-readers book ''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'', written by [[Joe Johnston]].<ref name="AoT" />

*''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'' {{1st}}
